pbr_zips_comment: Zips of PBR maps at fixed URLs (ambientCG, TextureCan): written as <dest>/<id>/<id>_albedo/normal/arm(/emission).jpg; `browser` fetches with a browser's User-Agent; `gain` multiplies a map's values (the armours' metals: a brighter albedo and more roughness, for a true metal is black in a dim dungeon).

pbr_zips.use: lava: crust and molten channels (TextureCan ground_0027)
Gehennom floors: crust with glowing veins
the rock the main dungeon is cut into; obsidian walls (Gehennom, Vlad's Tower)
chain and ring mail on the hero
plate, splint, scale and dragon scale mail on the hero

painted_comment: Textures painted by tools/art_paint.py, from one written before in the run when `from` names it (`image`: one inside a GLB): `rot` turns a base character's skin into a corpse's (`eyes`: where they lie in the image, to sink them), `bone` into a lich's (`nose`: where it lies, a hole), `wraps` winds linen over the image (open at the `eyes`), `pale` takes a coat's colour away so that a tint shows as itself, `lift` lights a dark coat up (to about `light` on the whole) so that it takes a tint and stays seen on a dark floor; `relief` keeps only what is lighter or darker than what is round it within `radius` pixels, about `light` everywhere; `warts` lays a coarse hide over a creature's own maps (`albedo`; `normal` and `orm` inside the GLB `from`); `face` gives a base character's skin a face that reads at a distance (`eyes`, `nose`, `mouth` where they lie; `stubble`; `war` paint: woad or kohl); `granite` paints a boulder's own albedo grey, speckled and chipped; `fur`, `scales`, `weave`, `floral`, `forged`, `marble`, `marble_slabs` and `pile` paint a material's three maps (`out` + _albedo, _normal, _arm) from nothing, `size` square; `winingas` paints them from nothing too; `lames` and `ringmail` paint them on a .gltf's meshes (`from`, `mesh` or `meshes`) by their UVs, the pattern laid by each texel's place on the body.

painted.use: zombies: the base character's skin, dead
liches: the base character's skin dried tight over the skull
mummies: the base character wound in linen, by its skin's layout
a kobold mummy: the Puglin wound in linen
the Puglin without its green, for a kind's own colour: a kobold zombie
the imp without its red, for a demon's own colour
the rats' coats lit up: a rat stays seen on a brown floor, each kind in its tint
the Ranger outfit's painting without its colours (seams, stitches, folds, worn edges): what its heroes dress in cloth or leather keeps it under the dye
the Peasant outfit's painting without its colours, as the Ranger's
a man's face that reads at a distance: shadowed sockets, lit bridge, hollow cheeks, stubble
the same, shaven (a Samurai, a Monk)
a Barbarian's: a band of woad across the eyes, run down the cheeks
a woman's face that reads at a distance
a Valkyrie's: the eyes lined in kohl
a Barbarian's: woad across the eyes
a pelt worn by a hero (a Valkyrie's, a Barbarian's): locks of hair lying down the cape, pale to take a tint
a dragon's hide: overlapping scales, each its own size, lean and shade, a few chipped, glossier in the middle than at the edges, pale to take its dye
a dragon's wings: thin membrane, broad veins fanned across it and finer ones off them, pale to take its dye
a hero's cloak, cape and robe: a wool twill, pale to take a tint
a Tourist's Hawaiian shirt: hibiscus and leaves on red, in its own colours
helmets: hammered steel, scratched, with patches of dark scale; glossy where rubbed, rough in the scale
a Samurai's cuirass on the Ranger outfit's body (its UVs; the woman's share them): laced lacquered lames, a lacquered plate over the chest, in its own colours
ring mail on the Ranger outfit's body and sleeves (a Knight's, a Barbarian's): iron rings sewn on leather in lapping rows, in its own colours
a troll's hide: warts and creases over the Puglin's own painting and relief (its UVs)
boulders: the boulder's own painting in grey granite, speckled, chipped (Sokoban's read as pink sponge)
marble (altars, fountains, inlays): polished white, veined grey with a touch of gold
a marble floor (the Oracle's centre, Ludios): the marble laid in slabs, fine joints between
a rug's pile that takes a tint: tufts, knot rows, worn patches
a Valkyrie's legs: wool bands wound round them under crossed thongs, pale to take a tint

turned_comment: Rigged models written before in the run (`from`) with bones turned in every clip by tools/gltf_turn.py: `raise` {bone: degrees} about the body's forward axis (from `back` to `front`), the way that lifts the bone's tip; `stretch` {bone: factor} sets a bone that much further from its parent, the skin between drawn out.

turned.use: grown dragons: their wings beat raised over their backs (the babies' spread)
the jabberwock: a grown dragon's body on a long neck

smoothed_comment: Rigged models written before in the run (`from`) whose low-poly mesh (`mesh`) tools/gltf_smooth.py rounds: each triangle cut in four, `steps` times, the new corners curved out the way the surface bends (nothing shrinks), the skeleton and clips kept byte for byte.

smoothed.use: baby dragons: round, not folded into flat facets
grown dragons: round, not folded into flat facets
apes, round (CC-BY as the gorilla above: Poly by Google)
yetis and sasquatches, the body round under the same shag (CC-BY as above)

blender_comment: Models made in Blender by tools/blender/<script>.py: static models rigged with the skeleton and clips of a Quaternius animal (rig_quadruped), centaurs put together from the horse and a base character (centaur), things worn round the neck of each outfit body they are fitted to, a stethoscope (also on the floor) and a tourist's camera on its strap (neck). URLs are downloaded (and locked); other paths are files above. fetch_art.py runs Blender when it finds one ($BLENDER, `blender` on the PATH, /Applications/Blender.app); without it the committed models are kept and only the downloads are checked. CC-BY models go to ccby/, see CREDITS.md.
